Pair-difference normals force r≤1/√2 and diagonal center. At r=1/√2 each k=|J| inequality gives t≤1−1/√2 for k=0, equality for k=1, and lower bound a_k=1/[2(1+√((k+1)/2))] for k≥2, maximized at k=2. The −1 normal has redundant bound for d≥3, but enforces t≥0 for d=2.
